incoming.name: Clifton Suspension Bridge
incoming.excerpt: The Clifton Suspension Bridge is a suspension bridge, spanning the Avon Gorge and linking Clifton in Bristol to Leigh Woods in North Somerset, UK.

outgoing.name: Clifton Suspension Bridge
outgoing.excerpt: The Clifton Suspension Bridge, an icon of Bristol, crosses the gorge.

outgoing.name: Invertebrate
outgoing.excerpt: The gorge is also home to many rare invertebrate species.

outgoing.name: Iron Age
outgoing.excerpt: There are three Iron Age hill forts overlooking the gorge, as well as a more recent observatory.

outgoing.name: Jackdaw
outgoing.excerpt: The gorge also houses large populations of Jackdaw and horseshoe bats, both of which find homes in the caves and bridge buttresses.
